description: A formal, elegant dining room designed in a French classical style with refined neoclassical architectural detailing. The entire feature wall behind the dining table is covered in an elaborate system of applied raised panel moulding — multiple nested rectangular frames at two heights — painted in a warm creamy off-white. The ceiling features a prominent oval coffered medallion with layered plaster moulding profiles and dentil detailing around its perimeter. A warm amber cove glow emanates from within the ceiling oval, softly illuminating the plaster molding from below and creating a halo of warmth on the ceiling plane. The floors are large-format polished white marble or porcelain tile. The dining table is a large round marble-topped table with a white and grey vein marble surface and a black lacquered or ebonized pedestal base with gilt brass accents. Surrounding it are six upholstered dining chairs with rounded barrel-back forms in mid-grey taupe velvet on slender black lacquered legs with brushed gold toe caps. A clear glass bud vase at the center of the table holds a loose arrangement of blush and cream roses with soft greenery. To the far left, white painted flat-front cabinetry of a butler's pantry or kitchen is barely visible. To the right, a narrow floor-to-ceiling glass door with a matte black frame opens to an adjacent space. Camera is at standing eye-level, approximately 5–6 feet, shooting a centered symmetrical wide view of the full dining room including the table, feature wall, and ceiling detail.
